name: F01 buildCellVdoc: the first body line is not floored (the pre-cure bound)
why: a start of 0.5 makes the loop start on 1.5 and `lines[1.5].trim()` throws; -5e-324 + 1 rounds to 1, so line 0 is dropped

name: F02 buildCellVdoc: the first body line is the CEIL of the start
why: a start of 0.5 begins the body on line 2, where the rule `i > 0.5` begins it on line 1

name: F03 buildCellVdoc: the first body line is the floor of start + 1
why: the sum rounds first: -5e-324 + 1 is 1, so a start of -5e-324 drops line 0 that `i > -5e-324` keeps

name: F04 buildCellVdoc: the first body line is the TRUNC of the start
why: trunc(-0.5) is -0, so a start of -0.5 begins the body on line 1, where `i > -0.5` begins it on line 0

name: F05 buildCellVdoc: the last body line is the CEIL of the sum
why: a start of 0.5 over two lines ends the body on line 3, where `i <= 2.5` ends it on line 2

name: F06 buildCellVdoc: the last body line is the floor of the start plus the count
why: the floor of the start before the sum: 1.9999999999999998 + 2 rounds to 4 (a tie, to even), floor(1.9999999999999998) + 2 is 3

name: F07 buildCellVdoc: the last body line is floored (a respelling)
why: EQUIVALENT: the loop compares it only with a whole `i`, and `i <= last` is `i <= floor(last)` for a whole `i` (NaN fails both); the cure at 2c85c77 had this floor and 5f6c7fc dropped it
